items.title: you need to self-host Google Photos RIGHT NOW!!
items.summary:
Access your photos, your Immich server and your whole home lab from anywhere, for free, with Twingate: https://ntck.co/twingate_immich

Google has pretty much every photo and video of my family's life sitting on its servers, and I'm done with that. So I replaced Google Photos with Immich, a free, open source photo app you host yourself, running on a spare laptop and an external hard drive. No cloud. It still gives me everything I wanted from Google Photos: automatic phone backup, memories, face recognition, a map, and AI search that runs locally, plus access from anywhere with Twingate. Then I show you my real family server, 19 terabytes of memories going back to 2006 on an old gaming PC with an RTX 3090, and how I back it all up.
